name: Media Manager
description: Finds movies and TV shows on Usenet, streams them through AltMount and adds them to Plex. AltMount comes included; Plex can be installed too.
longDescription:
Media Manager finds the movies and TV shows you ask for, picks a good release on your Usenet indexers, streams it through AltMount (no waiting for downloads) and adds it to Plex. A title only counts as done when Plex shows it. Requests can come from the website or from Seerr.

What you need

  • A Usenet news-server account and at least one Newznab indexer.
  • Plex, or tick Also install Plex during the install.
  • Optional: a free TMDB token for searching titles (not needed with Seerr).

What gets installed: Media Manager (website, API and database) and AltMount, with a Cosmos address for the website. Logins are entered on the website afterwards and stored encrypted.

Getting started takes four steps on the Kom i gang page: sign in with Plex, add your news-server login, add an indexer, and press Brug anbefalet opsætning, which sets up the library folders and a quality profile. The website is in Danish.
